All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, java.io.Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseDatatype, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseElement, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.ICompositeType
public class FhirIdentifier
extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier
This class is a subclass of Identifier.
It contains functionalities for converting CDA R2 II into HL7 FHIR Identifier and vice versa.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
